title: "Member 1 Hadley W"

Your exploratory data analysis of the team datasets go here.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(tidycensus)
```

```{r}
df = st_read("../data/raw/shp_trans_transit_count_headway_sum/")
```

```{r}
tracts <- get_acs(
  geography = "tract",
  variables = "B19013_001", 
  state = "MN",
  year = 2022,
  geometry = TRUE 
)
```

```{r}
st_crs(tracts)
st_crs(df)

lines <- st_transform(df, st_crs(tracts))


```

```{lines_tracts <- st_join(lines, tracts)}
lines_tracts <- st_join(lines, tracts)
```

```{r}
names(lines_tracts)
```

```{r}
tract_summary <- lines_tracts %>%
  group_by(GEOID) %>%
  summarise(
    total_trips = sum(TripCount, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_income = first(estimate)
  )
```


```{r}
tracts_map <- tracts %>%
  left_join(
    st_drop_geometry(tract_summary),
    by = "GEOID"
  )

metro_tracts <- tracts_map %>%
  filter(grepl("Hennepin|Ramsey|Dakota|Anoka|Washington|Scott|Carver", NAME))
```


```{r}
# How many transit lines didn't match any tract?
sum(is.na(lines_tracts$GEOID))

# How many tracts have zero transit service?
sum(tract_summary$total_trips == 0, na.rm = TRUE)

# Distribution of TripCount — check for outliers
summary(lines_tracts$TripCount)
hist(lines_tracts$TripCount, breaks = 50)

# How many metro tracts have missing income data?
sum(is.na(metro_tracts$median_income))
```

```{r}
# Scatterplot with a smoother
ggplot(metro_tracts, aes(x = median_income, y = total_trips)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::dollar) +
  labs(title = "Transit trips vs. median income by tract",
       x = "Median household income", y = "Total trip count")

# Log-transform if TripCount is heavily skewed
ggplot(metro_tracts, aes(x = median_income, y = log1p(total_trips))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth()
```

```{r}
ggplot(metro_tracts) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = log1p(total_trips)), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "log(trips+1)") +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Transit trip density by census tract")

# Side-by-side income vs transit
library(patchwork)
p1 <- ggplot(metro_tracts) + geom_sf(aes(fill = median_income), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::dollar) + theme_void()
p2 <- ggplot(metro_tracts) + geom_sf(aes(fill = log1p(total_trips)), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma") + theme_void()
p1 + p2
```


```{r}
metro_tracts %>%
  mutate(county = str_extract(NAME, "Hennepin|Ramsey|Dakota|Anoka|Washington|Scott|Carver")) %>%
  group_by(county) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_trips = mean(total_trips, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_income = mean(median_income, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_tracts = n()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_trips))
```
